en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father, my brother, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan all narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā Al-‘Aťťār, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali Al-Būfaki, from Sandal (Safwān ib Yaḥyā), from ‘Abdillāh ibn Bukayr, from ‘Abdillāh ibn Zurārah, who said:

I heard Abā ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) say, “Verily on the Day of Judgment, those who have gone to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain ibn ‘Ali (a.s.) will be given preference over others.” I asked, “What kind of preference?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “They will enter Paradise forty years before others. (They will enter it) while others will have to wait in the Desert (of Judgment) and undergo the judgment process.”
